question: Which marks distinguish one ripe for grace-descent?
premises: dispassion, enjoyment-aversion, some duty, and discrimination mark the candidate
good company and constant supreme-Lord worship-practice complete the marks
inference: Descent-readiness shows in dispassion through constant worship-practice.
plain_english: Dispassion, enjoyment-aversion, some duty, discrimination — good company, constant supreme-Lord worship-practice.
